meta.skip_reason: Backend and frontend services offline at audit time

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection — CVSS 9.8
escalations.escalate_reason: Template injection — requires code-path audit to verify no user-controlled template input exists
escalations.fix_complete_when: npm audit fix applied AND TheGuardians confirms no user-controlled template injection vectors

escalations.title: Vite Path Traversal — dev server source leak
escalations.escalate_reason: Dev server path traversal — if dev server is exposed to untrusted networks, source maps are readable

escalations.title: esbuild Dev Server CORS Bypass — CVSS 5.3
escalations.escalate_reason: Dev server CORS bypass — any website can read dev server responses if exposed
escalations.immediate_fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite (includes esbuild fix)

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search not wired — 5 tests will fail at CI
p1_findings.recommendation: Add GET /api/search?q= route handler filtering work items by title/description, register in app.ts. Return {data: WorkItem[]}. Test contract already complete in search.test.ts.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly — service layer missing
p2_findings.detail: 12 store call sites across both route files. CLAUDE.md: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts wrapping store calls. Route handlers become thin HTTP adapters.

p2_findings.title: dependency_check_duration histogram missing — FR-dependency-metrics gap
p2_findings.detail: FR-dependency-metrics specifies 4 metrics; only 3 implemented. dependencyCheckDuration histogram absent.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add dependencyCheckDurationHistogram export in metrics.ts, instrument isReady()/hasUnresolvedBlockers() calls in dependency.ts.

p2_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md: 74 FRs with 0% source coverage
p2_findings.detail: 74 FRs (FR-001 through FR-069+) covering FeatureRequests, BugReports, DevelopmentCycles, Tickets, and React SPA have zero source implementation.
p2_findings.recommendation: Decision required: mark spec as PLANNED (Phase N) in document header, or archive if superseded. Do NOT run through TheFixer pipeline.

p2_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md: 10 FRs with 0% source coverage
p2_findings.detail: 10 FRs (FR-TMP-001–010) for risk classification, Playwright E2E, auto-PR, AI review, auto-merge. No implementation. Source/E2E/tests/ is empty.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Plans/ entry for this feature with PENDING status. FR-TMP-007/008/009 touch platform/ — solo session only.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer misses 84 spec FRs — false 100% signal
p2_findings.detail: Enforcer targets only Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md. Reports PASSED while 74% of spec requirements have no coverage signal.
p2_findings.recommendation: Update enforcer to also scan Specifications/*.md for FR IDs and cross-reference against source, OR document that enforcer scope is intentionally limited to workflow-engine plan.

p2_findings.title: Express.js qs DoS — CVSS 5.3
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update express in Source/Backend (→ express@4.22.2+). Auto-fixes qs transitive dep.

p2_findings.title: uuid buffer bounds check — CVSS 7.5
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update uuid in Source/Backend. Requires major version bump 9.x → 11.x. Update package.json constraint from ^9.0.0 to ^11.0.0.

p2_findings.title: Frontend node_modules missing (build blocker) + Vitest cascading vulnerabilities
p2_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm install && npm update vite vitest (→ vitest@4.1.7)

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable without justification in 2 frontend files
p3_findings.recommendation: Replace with proper useCallback dep array or add inline comment explaining intentional omission.

p3_findings.title: Silent error swallow in API client catch block
p3_findings.recommendation: Log parse failure (debug level) or annotate with comment explaining intentional recovery. CLAUDE.md rule: never swallow errors silently.

p3_findings.title: Duplicate frontend test files — ambiguous coverage
p3_findings.recommendation: Delete root-level versions, consolidate all cases into tests/pages/ versions.

p3_findings.title: brace-expansion ReDoS — CVSS 6.5
p3_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix in Source/Backend (auto-updates to ^1.1.13). Included in express update.

p3_findings.title: PostCSS XSS — CVSS 6.1
p3_findings.recommendation: npm update vite in Source/Frontend (includes postcss@8.5.10+). Low runtime risk — build-time only.

p3_findings.title: ws uninitialized memory disclosure — CVSS 4.4
p3_findings.recommendation: npm update ws in Source/Frontend. Also resolved by vite ecosystem update.

p4_findings.title: Non-standard Verifies reference in DebugPortalPage.tsx
p4_findings.recommendation: Map to a real FR-XXX identifier or remove the comment.

p4_findings.title: License compliance audit — all MIT (informational)
p4_findings.recommendation: No action required. All 645+ dependencies are MIT-compatible. No GPL/AGPL risk.

block_deployment.command: Add route handler to Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register in app.ts

cd Source/Backend && npm update express uuid
